# GoldenMatch Action

> Deduplicate data files in CI, report duplicate and cluster counts, and gate a pull request on a duplicate threshold.

## Usage

```yaml
- uses: benseverndev-oss/goldenmatch/packages/actions/goldenmatch@main
  with:
    files: "data/*.csv"
```

## Inputs

- `files` -- glob for the data files to deduplicate (required)
- `config` -- path to a goldenmatch YAML config
- `exact` -- comma-separated columns for exact-match keys
- `fuzzy` -- comma-separated `field:threshold` pairs, e.g. `name:0.85`
- `max-duplicates` -- fail the job above this many duplicate rows
- `python-version` -- Python to run on
- `version` -- goldenmatch version to install

## Outputs

- `clusters`, `duplicates`, `files-processed`

## Authoritative sources

Read these instead of inferring behaviour from `action.yml`. An input list
gives you names and types; it cannot tell you which defaults are deliberate
or what a knob protects against:

- https://docs.bensevern.dev/docs/goldenmatch -- full documentation for the underlying tool.
- `goldenmatch/llms.txt` -- ships inside the goldenmatch wheel this action installs (`Path(goldenmatch.__file__).parent / "llms.txt"`), written for machine readers.
- https://docs.bensevern.dev/docs/llms.txt -- index of every Golden Suite surface.
- https://github.com/benseverndev-oss/goldenmatch -- source, issues, and the decision records.

## Things that are decided, not incidental

- **Zero-config dedupe is disabled in this action on purpose.** One of `config`, `exact` or `fuzzy` is required. The local auto-config controller can turn on cross-encoder rerank for a 3+ field weighted matchkey, which downloads a model -- so CI would reach the network on an input that looks purely local. Requiring explicit keys keeps the action hermetic.
- Duplicate count and cluster count are different numbers. A cluster is a group of records judged to be one entity; duplicates are the rows beyond the first in each cluster. Gate on whichever one you mean.
